summary: MBody AI Ltd. (formerly Check-Cap Ltd.) filed a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, announcing the completion of its corporate name change following the August 26, 2026 merger with MBody AI Corp. and a $10.0 million ordinary-share-only underwritten public offering on August 27, 2026. The filing discloses no per-share price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation, but carries the deal into a completed strategic/merger event rather than a routine current report. Shares continue trading on Nasdaq under ticker MBAI; the reverse-split-adjusted price and offering terms are not stated. The transaction structurally combined the operating business with the public shell, and the offering provides growth capital for customer deployments and the MBody AI Orchestrator. Risk-arb angle: watch for post-combination trading dynamics, dilution from the offering, and any resale/registration overhang.
